abilities.name: Flowing Eddies

High plunge frames also exist in gcsim (swap: 68, N: 58, E: 58, Q: 59, D: 45, J: 86). lowPlungeFrames used per recipe convention.

abilities.name: Pressurized Floe
_curatorNotes: Two-press skill: initial E (Upward Thrust, modeled as base frames: skillThrustFrames) starts Pers Timer (10s self-status). While Pers Timer is active, E triggers Shattering Pressure detonation at current pressure level — modeled as two variants. Reviewer to decide how to display the two-press pattern in the rotation timeline.

Pers Timer is a 10s self-status (persTimeKey = 'freminet-pers-time') on the caster — not a summon, no entity spawned. Canceled on detonation (DeleteStatus on detonateSkill). Reviewer to represent as a buff window.
Arkhe: Pneuma (Spiritbreath Thorn) fires at frame 62 from initial E cast, with 9-second ICD (skillAlignedICD = 9×60 = 540 frames). Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

Shattering Pressure (Lv 0–3) variant frames from gcsim skillPressureFrames[0]; Lv 4 from skillPressureFrames[1]. Variant selection depends on runtime skillStacks count, not constellations. Reviewer to model condition.

At Lv 4 (skillStacks >= 4), the next Normal Attack input auto-detonates Shattering Pressure instead of dealing a normal hit (gcsim attack.go checks skillStacks >= 4 before normal attack). Animation uses skillPressureFrames[1]. Reviewer to decide planner treatment.
During Subnautical Hunter mode (Q active), skill CD is reduced to 3s (3×60 frames) instead of the base 10s — see burst _curatorNotes.
abilities.description:
Performs an upward thrust that deals Cryo DMG and causes Freminet to enter Pers Timer for 10s.
While Pers Timer is active, his Elemental Skill will turn into Shattering Pressure.

Shattering Pressure
Executes different sorts of attacks based on the Pressure Level of Pers Timer, and then cancels Pers Timer.
·Level 0: Unleashes a vertical cut, dealing Cryo DMG.
·Levels 1 to 3: Unleashes a vertical cut alongside Pers, dealing Cryo DMG and Physical DMG. DMG dealt scales based on Pressure Level.
·Level 4: Borrows the power of a fully-pressurized Pers to deal Physical DMG. Meanwhile, Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies will be replaced by Shattering Pressure.

Pers Timer
When Freminet uses Normal Attacks, he will also unleash waves of frost that deal Cryo DMG and increase Pers's Pressure Level.
The accompanying Cryo DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, after using the upward thrust, a Spiritbreath Thorn in the form of another upward thrust will be created, dealing Pneuma-aligned Cryo DMG.

abilities.name: Shadowhunter's Ambush
_curatorNotes: Subnautical Hunter mode is a 10s self-status (burstKey = 'freminet-stalking') canceled when Freminet swaps off-field (onExitField event listener in burst.go). Not a summon — no entity spawned. Status reduces skill CD to 3s (70% reduction from base 10s) and doubles frost DMG from Pers Timer normal attacks. Reviewer to model as self-buff window.

[A7b] Q skill-CD reset AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (implement-first): cdReset effect mirroring the wired Kazuha-C1 shape (gcsim ResetActionCooldown in burst.go; base-kit, unconditional). The separate Subnautical 3s-CD mechanic (70% reduction while the 10s mode holds) remains unauthored — different mechanic, needs a mode window + cooldownModifiers.
abilities.description:
Unleashes a wave of untouchable cold, dealing AoE Cryo DMG, resetting the CD of the Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe," and causing Freminet to enter the Subnautical Hunter mode for 10s.

While in Subnautical Hunter mode, Freminet's resistance to interruption will increase, and his Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe" will obtain the following buffs:
·CD is decreased by 70%.
·Normal Attacks will increase the Pers Timer by 1 additional Pressure Level, and the frost released by his Normal Attacks deal 200% of their original DMG.

These effects will be canceled when Freminet leaves the field.
